title: A closer look at stock charts
summary: Stock pages now open with a candlestick chart, with candle intervals, indicators and drawing tools within reach.

items.title: Choose the view you need
items.description: Switch between candles and a line chart, and choose candle intervals from one minute to one day.

items.title: Add your own analysis
items.description: Turn on moving averages, RSI or MACD, and mark price levels or draw trend lines directly on the chart.

screenshots.alt: SpaceX candlestick chart in Oren with the one-hour interval selected, an Indicators menu, and drawing tools on the left.
